\chapter{CyberArk Conjur -\textgreater{} Akeyless}\label{doc-conjur-migration}}

Two separate problems:

How

\textbf{Secret values} & Akeyless Gateway \emph{Automatic Migration}, type \texttt{conjur} (static secrets only): \texttt{gateway.yaml\ -\textgreater{}\ migrations.conjur} (\texttt{akeyless\_gateway\_migration\_conjur}) or \texttt{akeyless\ gateway-create-migration\ -\/-type\ conjur\ ...}. Needs a Conjur identity that can read every variable; private CA -\textgreater{} make the bundle available on the Gateway and set \texttt{CONJUR\_SSL\_CERT\_PATH}. \\
\textbf{Authorization} (policies, hosts, layers, groups, permits, grants) & Not migrated by Akeyless. \texttt{scripts/conjur2akeyless.py} translates Conjur policy YAML into model roles + a bindings report. \\
\end{longtable}

\hypertarget{translation-rules}{%
\section{Translation rules}\label{translation-rules}}

\begin{longtable}[]{@{}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\columnwidth - 2\tabcolsep) * \real{0.4133}}
  >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{(\columnwidth - 2\tabcolsep) * \real{0.5667}}@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
\begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Conjur
\end{minipage} & \begin{minipage}[b]{\linewidth}\raggedright
Akeyless model
\end{minipage} \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
\bottomrule\noalign{}
\endlastfoot
\texttt{!variable\ \textless{}policy\textgreater{}/\textless{}id\textgreater{}} & item \texttt{\textless{}item-prefix\textgreater{}/\textless{}policy\textgreater{}/\textless{}id\textgreater{}} \\
\texttt{execute} (fetch value) & \texttt{read} (+ \texttt{list}) \\
\texttt{read} (see metadata) & \texttt{list} \\
\texttt{update} (set value) & \texttt{update} (+ \texttt{list}) \\
a role with permits (layer, group, host, user, policy) & one role \texttt{\textless{}role-prefix\textgreater{}conjur/\textless{}kind\textgreater{}-\textless{}id\textgreater{}} with exact-path rules \\
\texttt{!grant\ role:\ A,\ member:\ B} & Akeyless has no role nesting -\textgreater{} B is bound to A\textquotesingle s role too (transitive) \\
host / user identities & \texttt{bindings.yaml}: Akeyless roles each identity needs; you choose auth method + sub-claims \\
\texttt{!webservice}, \texttt{!deny}, \texttt{!revoke}, \texttt{!delete}, permits on non-variables & reported in \texttt{REPORT.md}, not translated \\
\end{longtable}

Anchored statement groups (\texttt{-\ \&variables\ {[}\ !variable\ a,\ ...\ {]}} with \texttt{resources:\ *variables}) are
supported. Annotations are ignored.

\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize,breaklines,breakanywhere,frame=leftline,framerule=1.2pt,rulecolor=\color{wo-rule},xleftmargin=6pt]
python3 scripts/conjur2akeyless.py root.yml prod.yml --item-prefix /conjur --role-prefix /governance/roles/ --out export/conjur
\end{Verbatim}

authn-jwt (CI, GitHub/GitLab) & OAuth2/JWT & \texttt{repository}, \texttt{ref} / \texttt{project\_path} \\
authn-k8s & Kubernetes & via Gateway K8s auth config; \texttt{bound\_namespaces}, \texttt{bound\_sa\_names} \\
authn-iam & AWS IAM & \texttt{bound\_aws\_account\_id}, \texttt{bound\_role\_name} \\
authn-azure & Azure AD & \texttt{bound\_tenant\_id}, \texttt{bound\_spid} \\
authn-oidc / LDAP (humans) & OIDC / SAML / LDAP & \texttt{groups} \\
API key hosts & API key or Universal Identity (prefer an identity-based method) & - \\
\end{longtable}

Procedure: translate -\textgreater{} fill bindings as \texttt{associations} -\textgreater{} move \texttt{roles/conjur.yaml} into
\texttt{terraform/model/roles/} -\textgreater{} tests + plan -\textgreater{} run the Gateway migration into the same prefix -\textgreater{}
compare migrated item names with the generated rule paths (\textbf{VERIFY} the naming the migration
produces) -\textgreater{} cut consumers over -\textgreater{} decommission Conjur policy.
